decision_rule: Recommend Codex only when repository-mechanical execution, deterministic large-scale repair, or CI/workflow debugging is materially better suited to a coding agent. Keep mathematical classification, literature judgment, transfer analysis, and arsenal decisions with ChatGPT.

handoff_contract.codex_request_rule: When recommended, emit a ready-to-paste Codex request naming the exact repository paths, failing invariant or mechanical task, expected edits, checks, and stop conditions. When not recommended, CODEX_REQUEST must be empty.
handoff_contract.codex_result_rule: Codex output never self-certifies mathematical or literature claims. ChatGPT must review any mathematical meaning introduced by repository changes before accepting them into StructureRadar.

work_interaction.note: Codex is for repository-mechanical work; Work is for external literature breadth and long document synthesis. Either or both may be declined by the operator without changing the other recommendation.
